answer.room: a large, empty, bright living room: white walls, warm honey-toned parquet, a balcony door with a blue-and-white striped awning outside and a window on the back wall; a neutral, light canvas ready for a colorful bohemian style

pieces.piece: a mustard velvet sofa against the long right-hand wall, facing the balcony
pieces.why: it is the heart of the living room and the color anchor the client asked for: mustard velvet glows against the white walls and harmonizes with the warm parquet
pieces.query:
Type: sofa, three-seater velvet sofa
Use: lounging and conversation; living room
Style: bohemian, retro, mid-century modern
Materials: velvet upholstery, wooden legs
Colors: mustard yellow, warm wood
Shape: generous rounded silhouette, channel or soft cushions, tapered wooden legs, substantial visual weight
Feel: cozy, joyful, inviting
Goes with: honey parquet, white walls, rattan, patterned rug; bohemian living room

pieces.piece: a rattan armchair across from the sofa, near the balcony door
pieces.why: the rattan brings natural texture and lightness, it is the quintessential bohemian piece, and it closes the conversation area facing the sofa
pieces.query:
Type: armchair, rattan lounge armchair
Use: relaxed seating and reading; living room
Style: bohemian, coastal
Materials: natural rattan, woven cane, seat cushion
Colors: natural honey rattan, cream or terracotta cushion
Shape: curved open frame, airy woven back, light visual weight
Feel: relaxed, natural, sunny
Goes with: mustard velvet sofa, warm parquet, white walls; bohemian living room

pieces.piece: a large patterned rug in the center of the room, under the sofa and the armchair
pieces.why: it defines the living area in this very open space and ties everything together with pattern and color over the parquet
pieces.query:
Type: rug, large patterned area rug
Use: defining the seating area; living room
Style: bohemian, traditional
Materials: wool or cotton, low pile or flatweave
Colors: terracotta, rust, mustard, deep blue, cream
Shape: large rectangle, kilim or vintage Persian-style pattern, fringed edges
Feel: warm, layered, lived-in
Goes with: mustard velvet sofa, rattan armchair, honey parquet; bohemian living room

pieces.piece: colorful patterned cushions on the sofa and the armchair
pieces.why: mixing patterns and colors is what makes the room look lived-in and cheerful, as the client asked
pieces.query:
Type: cushion, patterned throw pillows
Use: decorating the sofa and armchair; living room
Style: bohemian
Materials: cotton, embroidered or woven fabric, tassels
Colors: terracotta, teal, pink, deep blue, cream
Shape: assorted square and rectangular, tassels or fringe, mixed patterns
Feel: cheerful, eclectic, cozy
Goes with: mustard velvet sofa, rattan armchair, patterned rug; bohemian living room

pieces.piece: several plants in ceramic pots: a large one beside the balcony door and smaller ones on the bookcase and in the corners
pieces.why: the plants bring life and greenery to an empty room, and the ceramic pots add texture and earthy color
pieces.query:
Type: plant, potted indoor plants in ceramic pots
Use: bringing greenery and life; living room
Style: bohemian
Materials: glazed or handmade ceramic, terracotta
Colors: lush green, terracotta, cream, glazed blue
Shape: mix of tall leafy plant and small trailing plants, round pots of varied sizes
Feel: lively, natural, fresh
Goes with: rattan armchair, mustard sofa, warm parquet; bohemian living room

pieces.piece: a low bookcase with books under the back-wall window
pieces.why: it fills the wall under the window without blocking the light, and the books and objects on top make the room look lived-in
pieces.query:
Type: bookcase, low open bookcase
Use: storing books and displaying plants and objects; living room
Style: bohemian, mid-century modern
Materials: warm wood, rattan or cane details
Colors: warm honey or medium wood
Shape: long and low, open shelves, light visual weight
Feel: warm, personal, relaxed
Goes with: honey parquet, rattan armchair, ceramic pots; bohemian living room

pieces.piece: a round coffee table in front of the sofa, on the rug
pieces.why: the seating area needs a surface for drinks and books, and a round wood piece softens the arrangement
pieces.query:
Type: coffee table, round low table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor; living room
Style: bohemian, mid-century modern
Materials: solid wood, rattan or carved details
Colors: warm medium wood
Shape: round, low, sturdy base, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, casual, earthy
Goes with: mustard velvet sofa, patterned rug, rattan armchair; bohemian living room

pieces.piece: a floor lamp beside the sofa
pieces.why: the room is dark on the right-hand side, and a woven-shade lamp adds warm light and bohemian character
pieces.query:
Type: floor lamp, woven shade floor lamp
Use: warm reading and ambient light; living room
Style: bohemian, coastal
Materials: rattan or woven natural fiber shade, wood stand
Colors: natural rattan, warm wood
Shape: tall slim stand, rounded woven shade, light visual weight
Feel: warm, soft, cozy
Goes with: mustard velvet sofa, rattan armchair; bohemian living room

pieces.piece: a patterned throw over the sofa armrest
pieces.why: it adds another layer of texture and color, the casual lived-in look the client is after
pieces.query:
Type: throw, woven fringed blanket
Use: layering on the sofa; living room
Style: bohemian
Materials: cotton or wool, woven texture, fringe
Colors: terracotta, rust, cream
Shape: rectangular, fringed edges, chunky weave
Feel: cozy, relaxed, warm
Goes with: mustard velvet sofa, patterned cushions and rug; bohemian living room
